Hinweise zur Angebotsabgabe Anzahl Bewerber In Einklang mit § 51 Abs. 2 VgV wird die Zahl der zur Angebotsabgabe aufzufordernden Bewerber auf mindestens drei und höchstens fünf festgelegt. Die festgelegte Mindestzahl von drei Bewerbern entspricht den gesetzlichen Anforderungen für das Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb. Die vorgesehene Höchstzahl von fünf Bewerbern gewährleistet einen ausreichenden Wettbewerb und ermöglicht zugleich eine sachgerechte und wirtschaftliche Durchführung des weiteren Vergabeverfahrens. Der Auftragsgegenstand umfasst die Konzeption, Entwicklung, Implementierung und betriebliche Optimierung einer innovativen KI-basierten Individualsoftware. Die Prüfung und Bewertung der Angebote erfordert eine vertiefte fachliche Analyse der vorgeschlagenen Lösungsansätze sowie gegebenenfalls die Durchführung von Verhandlungsgesprächen. Mit zunehmender Zahl der einzubeziehenden Bieter steigt der hierfür erforderliche personelle und zeitliche Aufwand erheblich. Die Begrenzung auf höchstens fünf Bewerber dient daher dem Ziel, einen wirksamen Wettbewerb sicherzustellen und gleichzeitig ein effizientes und verhältnismäßiges Vergabeverfahren zu ermöglichen. Nach Einschätzung der Auftraggeberin ist bei einer Teilnehmerzahl von bis zu fünf Bewerbern ein ausreichender Wettbewerb gewährleistet. Sofern mehr als fünf geeignete Bewerber einen Teilnahmeantrag einreichen, erfolgt die Auswahl der zur Angebotsabgabe aufzufordernden Bewerber anhand der in den Vergabeunterlagen veröffentlichten Auswahlkriterien und der hierzu festgelegten Auswahlmatrix . Pakkuja kinnitab, et ta ei kaasa üle 10% hankelepingu maksumusest hankelepingu täitmisele alltöövõtjaid ega tarnijaid, kes on: 1. Vene Föderatsiooni kodanik, resident või Vene Föderatsioonis asutatud ettevõtja, sh füüsilisest isikust ettevõtja, juriidiline isik, asutus või muu üksus; 2. rohkem kui 50% ulatuses otseselt või kaudselt punktis 1 nimetatud isiku, asutuse või muu üksuse omandis; 3. punktis 1 või 2 nimetatud isiku, asutuse või muu üksuse esindaja või tegutseb sellise isiku juhiste alusel. ion. 1.6.3 Delivered product shall integrate A-GRA autonomy interface into the existing MTS Service Set creation tool. Upon selection of A-GRA, the Mission Planner Autonomy UI must dynamically reconfigure connection parameter fields (e.g., IPs, Ports, Serial) to match the A- GRA interface format and auto -populate with appropriate default values. The HSE provides thousands of services to young and old, in hospitals, health facilities and in communities across the country. Programme Aim The purpose of this training programme is to design, develop and deliver a training programme that build people’s understanding of self-harm and the role it plays in the life of a person who self-harms. The programme will build the knowledge and confidence of the learner to have a conversation if they are concerned that someone may be self-harming. The training programme should provide people who access it with a sense of hope and reassurance that people can build healthier coping mechanisms. Programme Objectives The training programme is intended to: Increase understanding of what self-harm is. Increase understanding of the relationship between self-harm and suicide. Build skills and confidence to engage with a person and speak openly about self-harm. Challenge the stigma surrounding self-harm Increase awareness of available supports and services Stage 1: An introduction to the subject of self-harm – communicating the ‘why’ functions of self-harm through lived experience experts. To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. 2.0 SCOPE The Contractor shall provide a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. The GUI shall be designed to allow an operator with basic TDL knowledge to achieve proficiency on core tasks in no more than three (3) standard working days. nual data entry. 3.1.3 Data and Issue Management: • 3.1.3.1 Management of TDL Differences: The software shall allow users to capture, document, and grade deviations from a standard TDL baseline directly within a platform's implementation record. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations. Scope The contractor shall furnish and deliver one (1) new trailer-mounted vacuum excavator system for use by the 88th Communications Squadron cable maintenance section. 2. Purpose The equipment is required to support the safe location and excavation of delicate buried fiber optic cables and the removal of water and organic sludge from manhole systems. 3. nd excavation of delicate buried fiber optic cables and the removal of water and organic sludge from manhole systems. 3. nt • Shall include a hose support arm, boom, or equivalent mechanism capable of supporting and positioning hoses over the excavation area. • Shall include all trailer components required for safe towing, transport, and field operation. 3.6 Hoses, Tools, and Accessories • Shall include hoses, fittings, tooling, and accessories necessary for normal operation. • Shall include all pumps, controls, tanks, and associated components required for the system to perform its intended mission upon delivery. 3.7 Documentation • Shall include operator manuals, maintenance documentation, and warranty information at time of delivery. 4. Requirement Description: The Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Equipment Life Cycle Management (ELCM) Program has identified Monitors: Physio: Cardiac Output: Bedside as a candidate for the Department of Veterans Affairs VA-wide (otherwise referred to as “national”) Non-Expendable Equipment (NX) contract award. A single award Requirements contract will be awarded IAW all terms, conditions, provisions, specifications, and schedule of this solicitation herein. Offers shall contain the terms for cost/price and technical capabilities of brand name or equal equipment. The Government reserves the right to award without discussions. The associated North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 339112 – Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing, Product Service Code: 6515 – Medical and Surgical Instruments, Equipment, and Supplies and the associated size standard is 1,000 employees. This procurement action is issued as full and open. This acquisition is for a single award Requirements contract with firm-fixed priced (FFP) delivery orders IAW FAR Subpart 16.5 for Becton Dickinson brand name or equal NX EQ Hemodynamic Monitors and accessories as identified in ATTACHMENT A – PRICE COST SCHEDULE - NX EQ HEMODYNAMIC MONITORS. Offerors shall provide a quote for all Contract Line-Item Numbers (CLINs) listed in ATTACHMENT A – PRICE COST SCHEDULE - NX EQ HEMODYNAMIC MONITORS. The ordering period is for one 12-month base year with four 12-month option years. Delivery is Free on Board (FOB) destination. The contractor shall not make copies of VA information except as specifically authorized and necessary to perform the terms of the contract. If copies are made for restoration purposes, after the restoration is complete, the copies shall be destroyed in accordance with VA Directive 6500, VA Cybersecurity Program and VA Information Security Knowledge Service. g.
